name: sparx — Bistro
tagline: A warm, working template for a restaurant that takes reservations.
description: A complete, working site for a neighbourhood restaurant: a real seasonal menu, and a live table-reservations flow (tables as bookable resources, party-size reservation services, opening hours, a cancellation policy) on the /reserve page. Warm bistro theme — candle-cream, deep olive-green, a warm amber accent. Pages: Home, Menu, Reserve, About, Visit. Shipped as Larkspur.
